meta.title: Rizz or Flop
meta.instructions: Your crush says something. Tap the least cringe of four replies before the bar runs out. Fast answers and streaks score more, and later rounds pay double and triple. The Rizz Tribunal judges every line. Two flops and the date is over; survive 12 rounds to win.

do.to: [min(10, 7 + fast / 100), min(10, 6 + streak), if fast > 200 then 11 else 9]
if picked < 0 then pick(content_ghosted) else pick(content_cringe)

node.text: = if heat() == 1 then 'LOW STAKES ROUND' else if heat() == 2 then 'HEAT x2: THEY ARE INTERESTED' else 'HEAT x3: FINAL BOSS DATE'

children.text: = if status == 'won' then 'IT IS GIVING RIZZ' else 'THE DATE IS OVER'
= str(right_count) + ' smooth  |  ' + str(wrong_count) + ' cringe  |  round ' + str(min(round + 1, 12))
